## Key Production Projects
- **BYOUR (Intelligent Hiring Infrastructure):** Multi-AZ AWS cloud infrastructure with automated GitLab CI/CD, Terraform/Terragrunt, AWS Bedrock integration, RDS read replicas, and Route53 automated failover (https://byour.co/).
- **UA-IE Car Scout (Live SaaS):** Cross-border automotive valuation engine with 172 automated tests (100% pass), 7 platform scrapers using direct Next.js data extraction, and Irish Revenue VRT & Customs tax calculations (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/ua-ie-car-scout).
- **AI Ticket Classifier:** Autonomous customer triage engine backed by 182 automated tests (Pytest), Dual-LLM circuit breaker (Gemini 2.0 Flash → OpenAI), rule engine <5ms short-circuit, tiered Redis rate-limiting, and Stripe billing (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/ai-ticket-classifier).
- **AWS S3 Simulator with Observability:** S3-compatible object storage emulator with MinIO core, complete PLG observability stack (Prometheus 15s scrapes, Loki, Promtail, Grafana dashboards), and automated Pytest test suite (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/aws-s3-simulator).
- **DealShop (Irish Bilingual Marketplace & Motors Portal):** Production Web & Mobile marketplace (dealshop.ie) and native Flutter Android app in Google Play (ie.dealshop.app). 1,647 automated tests (1,417 Vitest, 186 Playwright E2E, 62 Flutter tests), 3,776 translation keys (100% EN/GA parity), Cartell NCT verification, €250 Stripe Escrow holds, An Post courier API, and Strix AI pentested.
- **Docker Microservices & Traefik Load Balancing:** High-availability cluster orchestrating 3 scaled Node.js replicas behind Traefik reverse proxy, Redis 7 AOF persistent cache, and k6 load tests maintaining p95 < 200ms (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/docker-multi-container-demo).
- **Automated DevOps Node.js Boilerplate:** Production Express 5 server with automated Ansible provisioning playbooks, 16 Jest integration tests, 85.7% code coverage, and multi-stage Alpine Docker containerization (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/my-devops-node-app).
- **Bash Toolbox (SRE & DevOps Automation Suite):** 70 modular, zero-dependency shell utilities for Kubernetes, Docker, and Linux diagnostics with automated Bats & ShellCheck CI (https://github.com/ArtemRivnyi/bash-toolbox).

## Technical Case Studies & Architecture Blueprints
- **Dual-LLM Failover Architecture (Zero-Outage AI Microservices):** Production architectural blueprint on eliminating AI Single Points of Failure (SPOF) using Redis circuit breakers, Pydantic contracts, Prometheus observability, and automated hot-standby fallback from Google Gemini 2.0 Flash to OpenAI GPT-4o-mini with ~71% inference cost reduction (https://artemrivnyi.com/docs/dual-llm-failover-architecture.html).
- **UA-IE Car Scout Architecture (Market Intelligence & Tax Engine):** Real-time meta-search engine aggregating 6 automotive marketplaces across Ukraine and Ireland with dual-tier Cheerio/Puppeteer stealth scraping, live NBU central bank currency normalization, and Irish Revenue customs duty, VAT, and VRT statutory calculation engine with 172 automated tests (https://artemrivnyi.com/docs/ua-ie-car-scout-architecture.html).
- **AI Email Support Platform (Privacy-First On-Prem AI):** Decoupled enterprise support automation architecture using containerized local LLMs (Ollama/Gemma:7b), FAISS semantic vector retrieval (RAG) to prevent hallucinations, and asynchronous Redis Queue (RQ) workers processing incoming emails without cloud PII data leakage (https://artemrivnyi.com/docs/ai-email-support-architecture.html).
- **AWS S3 Simulator & Observability Architecture (Slashing Cloud Egress):** Self-contained, lightweight S3-compatible object storage emulator with MinIO core, eliminating cloud egress expenses in CI/CD by 100% and providing full-stack Prometheus + Loki + Promtail + Grafana dashboard observability (https://artemrivnyi.com/docs/aws-s3-simulator-architecture.html).
